title: QB8_C#q4 expanded CIC in its question stem as 'Consolidated Inspection Campaign' while its own answer body correctly taught the PSC 'Concentrated Inspection Campaign'
candidate_claim: August 2026 intake occurrence AUG-0277 records a candidate ask of 'Cic code.' from the 31 August 2026 sitting. Adjudicating that ask against QB8_C#q4 put a reader on the card, and the adjudication's vocabulary_note recorded the defect without correcting it: the card's question stem names it Consolidated Inspection Campaign while its own body correctly says Concentrated.
candidate_verdict: UPHELD. There is no port State control instrument or campaign called a Consolidated Inspection Campaign. The stem was wrong and the body was right, so the card contradicted itself and the wrong half was the half every derived surface copies.

authority.instrument: Joint Paris MoU / Tokyo MOU press release, 'CONCENTRATED INSPECTION CAMPAIGN ON CARGO SECURING', 3 August 2026
authority.verbatim_expansion: The Member Authorities of the Tokyo MOU and Paris MoU will undertake a Concentrated Inspection Campaign (CIC) on Cargo Securing of Cargo Units and Cargo Transport Units.
authority.verbatim_window: This CIC will be conducted from 1 September to 30 November 2026.
authority.verbatim_questionnaire: Port State Control Officers (PSCOs) will apply a questionnaire, developed by the Tokyo and Paris MOUs, to check how cargo securing obligations have been complied with.
authority.why_this_source: The two MOUs that run the campaign, defining their own abbreviation in their own announcement. This is the issuing body writing about itself, which is tier 1 for what the term IS - correction-workflow SKILL section 2a rule 1, the express definition in the governing source.
authority.currency_basis: Asked as SKILL section 8.2b requires - what has the publisher said MOST RECENTLY - rather than 'did some supersession I already suspect occur'. The 3 August 2026 announcement is the current campaign at the date of this correction and is the newest CIC statement either MOU has published; the Tokyo MOU CIC results index carries the earlier topics (MLC crew wages 2024, fire safety 2023, STCW 2022, stability 2021) under the same term, so the expansion is stable across the series and is not a 2026 rename.
authority.corroboration_in_repo: The MIW corpus already used the correct term everywhere else, which is itself evidence the stem was the outlier: the historical Written QI source layer carries 'concentrated inspection campaign' in three examiner-authored written stems and zero instances of 'consolidated'; solvedQP/QP2310, QP2412, questions-2022, questions-2023 and questions-2024, meoclass1/pastpapers and meoclass1/oralnotes/simon-notes-p4 all say 'concentrated'.
authority.access_limit_stated: Yes. The Paris MoU library page for concentrated inspection campaigns returned HTTP 404 at the time of this correction and no claim is made from it. Nothing here is asserted about the content of the CIC questionnaire itself, which neither MOU publishes in the press release.

propagation.source_of_truth: Exactly one editable stem exists: the q-card .q-text div, which oral_lib.parse_qb_file extracts and every derived surface consumes. The page's own table-of-contents link carried a second hand-maintained copy of the same wording inside the same file - no generator owns it and no gate compares it to the q-text - so it was corrected in the same edit. Both replacements are the identical 12-character swap Consolidated to Concentrated, so the file length is unchanged and the TOC truncation point does not move.
propagation.scope_pass: Swept every .html, .json, .jsonl, .csv and .md in the repository for the wrong phrase, case-insensitively. Before: 33 occurrences in 24 files. After: 26, and every remaining one is deliberate. NO independently authored candidate card carries the wrong phrase - the sweep of all meoclass1/, SQ/ and solvedQP/ HTML for any 'word Inspection Campaign' found QB8_C alone on 'consolidated' and every other candidate-facing page already on 'concentrated', so no scope-pass card correction was required and no second root was opened.
propagation.derived_regenerated: qb_content_index.json and the hub index.html Q_INDEX/qcount/hero regions via build_qb_content_index.py; meoclass1/examiner-index.html, SQ/examiner-index.html, SQ/index.html and EXAMINER_INDEX_SNAPSHOT.json via build_examiner_index.py; docs/study/study_mappings.json via build_study_mappings.py --force; meoclass1/topics.html and meoclass1/study.html via build_topic_pages.py. Nothing derived was hand-edited.
propagation.force_was_required: build_study_mappings.py is incremental and its cache key is the taxonomy digest, so an ordinary run reported skipped 1121 and left the stale stem in place. --force was needed. The forced re-derive changed the text of exactly TWO of 1121 mapping records and moved no topic assignment, no status and no id: QB8_C#q4 (this correction) and QB1_G#q32, which had still been carrying the truncated 'ms notice 1 of 202' stem that known_traps entry 50 corrected on the card - the card was fixed, the mapping store was never re-derived. That is a PRE-EXISTING staleness catch-up, not a change authorised by this correction. Status counts are identical before and after (ACCIDENTALLY_UNMAPPED 42, REVIEW_PENDING 66, VALID_MAPPED 1013); the remainder of the large textual diff is JSON key ordering only.
propagation.deliberately_left_standing: The correction's own changelog note in tools/oral/qb_content_index_governed.json and its rendered copy in meoclass1/qb_content_index.json each quote the rejected expansion once, in order to reject it - correction-workflow SKILL section 8.2a rule 2. The 26 remaining occurrences in meoclass1/oral-intelligence/examiner-audit/ are DATED EVIDENCE: examiner ledgers, prose-evidence CSVs, the 788 reconciliation, the gap and human-review queues, and the AUG-0277 adjudication that reported this very defect. They record what the corpus said when they were written, validate_oral_intake asserts that raw wording never drifts, and CURRENT_ORAL_QB_INVENTORY.json is itself a 759-question snapshot against a 761-question corpus. Rewriting them would falsify the audit trail, not clean it.

No card was created, deleted or renumbered. The corpus stays at 761 canonical questions across 86 QB files.
Examiner relationships stay at 958 across 7 examiners; QB8_C#q4's own attribution and confirmed tier are unchanged.

note: BOUNDED TERMINOLOGY CORRECTION TO A QUESTION STEM. Scope was one wrong word in one stem plus its in-file TOC copy, and the regeneration of every surface that copies it. No new card, no new root, no answer rewrite. The defect class is known_traps entry 50 - a stem is not decoration - and this is its second instance; the new lesson in entry 65 is that nothing in the release suite compares a stem against its own answer body, which is why a self-contradicting card survived a clean full-suite qualification. SUPERSESSION: NONE. No batch or correction manifest has ever declared QB8_C, so this card carries no prior authorised post-state and this record opens its chain rather than descending from one. Verified by scanning every batch_*_manifest.json and correction_*_manifest.json for the file: zero entries.
